---
title: Changelog
---

This page tracks user-visible updates. Entries are listed newest first.

## Entry Template

- **Version:** `vX.Y.Z`
- **Date (UTC):** `YYYY-MM-DD`
- **Changed:** What changed at a high level.
- **Why it matters:** User impact or expected behavior difference.
- **Affected areas:** Main files/components touched.

## v0.1.11

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-05-01
- **Changed:** Added source viewing/preview support so users can inspect stored source snapshots from source chips, including last-scraped metadata, and tightened source test refreshes to scrape only the URLs added to a test set.
- **Why it matters:** Users can verify cited source content in-app without triggering broad sandbox scrapes when evaluating a single added source.
- **Affected areas:** `interfaces/api/main.py`, `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.tsx`, `core/source_proposals.py`, `core/daily_connections_refresh.py`

## v0.1.10

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-03-04
- **Changed:** Removed visible trailing procedure-link blocks from responses, enabled source-only inline markdown hyperlink behavior, preserved yellow procedure-source highlighting, suppressed clarify follow-up questions when no sources are retrieved, and updated source metadata copy to include `(procedures in yellow)`.
- **Why it matters:** Responses stay full-length and cleaner, links are safer and grounded in retrieved sources, users get clearer source cues, and off-topic/no-source turns avoid unnecessary follow-up questions.
- **Affected areas:** `core/llmapi_flow.py`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_flow.py`, `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.tsx`, `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.stories.tsx`

## v0.1.9

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-03-04
- **Changed:** Applied strict source emission gating to all sources using raw score thresholds (`v_raw > 0.65` or `b_raw > 10.0`), limited procedure links to the top eligible result, and added procedure-source highlighting in chat chips and debug source rows.
- **Why it matters:** Off-topic and low-signal results no longer surface misleading sources, procedure links stay focused, and procedure content is easier to spot in the UI.
- **Affected areas:** `core/llmapi_shared.py`, `core/llmapi_retrieval.py`, `core/llmapi_flow.py`, `interfaces/api/main.py`, `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.tsx`, `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.stories.tsx`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_retrieval.py`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_flow.py`

## v0.1.8

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-03-03
- **Changed:** Added a low-signal retrieval gate using raw vector/BM25 score floors so off-topic prompts do not pass normalization into ranked results; updated fallback flow to classify these as out-of-scope, skip clarify/retry loops, and emit no sources.
- **Why it matters:** Prevents unrelated questions from showing misleading Connections sources and reduces unnecessary follow-up clarification prompts when retrieval confidence is clearly too low.
- **Affected areas:** `core/llmapi_shared.py`, `core/llmapi_retrieval.py`, `core/llmapi_flow.py`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_retrieval.py`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_flow.py`

## v0.1.7

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-02-23
- **Changed:** Added procedure-link-first answer behavior that detects step-based sources via `#tab-step{n}` markers, appends consistent `Procedure links` blocks, and keeps links at source-page level (no deep-link fragment navigation). Also tightened procedure-mode prompt brevity and backfilled procedure source metadata for historical messages in API hydration.
- **Why it matters:** Procedural responses stay concise and reliably route users to canonical source pages for full steps, while preserving consistent link behavior across fresh and historical chat turns.
- **Affected areas:** `core/llmapi_flow.py`, `core/llmapi_retrieval.py`, `interfaces/api/main.py`, `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.tsx`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_flow.py`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_retrieval.py`

## v0.1.6

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-02-23
- **Changed:** Added startup Quarto docs rendering for reference pages, added nightly connections refresh scripts with stale-page pruning support, and exposed `last_crawled` in release metadata so the version badge hover shows the latest crawl timestamp.
- **Why it matters:** Reference docs (including changelog) are generated on app load, nightly refresh operations can safely prune removed pages, and operators can quickly verify content freshness from the UI.
- **Affected areas:** `interfaces/api/main.py`, `core/daily_connections_refresh.py`, `core/fastlite_db.py`, `core/scrape.py`, `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.tsx`, `scripts/run-nightly-connections-refresh.bat`, `scripts/run-nightly-connections-refresh.cmd`, `docs/changelog.qmd`

## v0.1.5

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-02-18
- **Changed:** Added a clarification loop guard that suppresses repeated fallback clarifying questions after short user replies, excluded prior fallback-clarify assistant turns from rewrite/clarifier history, and added fallback loop diagnostics in debug payloads.
- **Why it matters:** Prevents repetitive clarification loops (for example after users answer with short confirmations like "traditional") and forces a best-effort actionable answer instead of asking the same question again.
- **Affected areas:** `core/llmapi_flow.py`, `interfaces/api/main.py`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_flow.py`, `interfaces/api/tests/test_api.py`

## v0.1.4

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-02-18
- **Changed:** Added clarify-or-retrieve fallback behavior when responses are likely to start with "I don't know," including a second local retrieval pass, one-question clarification fallback, and per-turn fallback diagnostics in debug payloads.
- **Why it matters:** Reduces dead-end answers by either finding better local context or asking a targeted follow-up question without changing the stream protocol.
- **Affected areas:** `core/llmapi_flow.py`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_flow.py`, `interfaces/api/tests/test_api.py`

## v0.1.3

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-02-18
- **Changed:** Collapsed chat source chips behind a compact arrow toggle row (`Sources: X`) with per-message expand/collapse behavior.
- **Why it matters:** Reduces chat message height and clutter while preserving quick access to sources and reuse visibility.
- **Affected areas:** `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.tsx`, `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.stories.tsx`

## v0.1.2

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-02-17
- **Changed:** Added a local source-overlap audit CLI and redesigned chat source chips to show readable source labels with per-answer reuse counts.
- **Why it matters:** Makes it clear when follow-up answers reuse versus introduce new sources, without changing retrieval or cache behavior.
- **Affected areas:** `core/source_overlap_audit.py`, `core/tests/test_source_overlap_audit.py`, `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.tsx`, `interfaces/client/src/components/ChatApp.stories.tsx`

## v0.1.1

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-02-17
- **Changed:** Added conditional glossary injection, dual retrieval merge for rewritten queries, runtime URL-canonical dedupe for sources/context, and startup URL cleanup with fail-open behavior.
- **Why it matters:** Reduces MyWay/Prepay topic bleed into unrelated answers, lowers rewrite-driven retrieval drift, and prevents duplicate encoded/decoded sources from dominating rankings.
- **Affected areas:** `core/llmapi_flow.py`, `core/llmapi_retrieval.py`, `interfaces/api/main.py`, `interfaces/api/tests/test_api.py`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_flow.py`, `core/tests/test_llmapi_retrieval.py`

## v0.1.0

- **Date (UTC):** 2026-02-10
- **Changed:** Implemented contextual query rewrite handling for multi-turn chat.
- **Why it matters:** Reduces ambiguity in answers and improves consistency when users ask follow-up questions.
- **Affected areas:** `core/llmapi_flow.py`, `core/llmapi.py`, `interfaces/api/main.py`
